description: This file defines an enum OverlayPanelFactory that provides static methods to create, animate, present, and dismiss NSPanel and NSWindow instances for overlay panels in a macOS application. It includes methods to configure panels' appearance, handle animations for presenting and dismissing windows, and manage event monitors.

methods.name: makePanel
methods.description: Creates and configures an NSPanel with specified properties such as size, style, shadow, and mouse event acceptance.

methods.name: animatePresent
methods.description: Animates the presentation of a window from a start frame to a target frame with fade-in effect.

methods.name: animateFrame
methods.description: Animates the window to a new frame with a smooth transition.

methods.name: applyFrame
methods.description: Sets the window's frame directly or with animation based on the flag.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Handles the logic for first-time presentation of a window with animation or quick display.

methods.name: animateDismiss
methods.description: Animates the window to move away and fade out, then executes a completion handler.

methods.name: animateDismissAndHide
methods.description: Animates the window dismissal and then hides it, executing a callback upon hiding.

methods.name: clearGlobalEventMonitor
methods.description: Removes an event monitor if present.
